sentences.en: The therapeutic scenario has moved from dapsone monotherapy in the 1970s to MDT using drugs such as dapsone monotherapy in the 1970s to MDT using drugs such as dapsone, rifampicin and clofazimine.

sentences.en: There was no significant difference in their median duration of successful monotherapy.

sentences.en: Significant advantages for Enbrel in combination with methotrexate compared with Enbrel monotherapy and methotrexate monotherapy were also observed after 24 months.
sentences.vi: Lợi ích đáng kể của Enbrel kết hợp với methotrexate so với Enbrel đơn trị liệu và methotrexate đơn trị liệu cũng được ghi nhận sau 24 tháng.
